query: Japan HFMD hand-foot-and-mouth disease national cases per sentinel (定点当たり報告数) Week 27 2026 provisional (速報) IDWR JIHS. Also confirmed Week 25 and Week 26 values, and week-over-week trajectory for weeks 20-27 of the 2026 season.
answer:
I've completed the research. Here's a summary of the key findings:

## Japan HFMD National Sentinel Data — 2026 Season

**Week 27 2026 (PROVISIONAL / 速報):** **7.03** cases per sentinel site
- Published 2026-07-14 by JIHS via IDWR
- Reporting week: 2026-06-29 to 07-05
- 15,845 total case reports; 27 of 47 prefectures above the 5.0 warning threshold
- First national breach of 5.0 in two years
- **Subject to revision** (next update 2026-07-21)

**Confirmed prior weeks:**
- **Week 25:** 3.40
- **Week 26:** 4.61 (cross-validated by two independent Jiho industry news sources citing JIHS; noted as the 7th consecutive weekly increase)

**Week-over-week trajectory (2026 season):**

| Week | Value | WoW change |
|------|-------|-----------|
| 22 | 1.41 | — |
| 23 | 1.98 | +40% |
| 24 | 2.75 | +38.9% |
| 25 | 3.40 | +24% |
| 26 | 4.61 | +36% |
| 27 | 7.03 (prov.) | +52% |

The national rate has risen **every week since Week 20** (per repeated JIHS statements), and the pace of increase accelerated into Week 27. Weeks 20–21 exact national values weren't precisely captured in available sources, but JIHS consistently confirms continuous increase from Week 20 onward.

**Caveat on forecasting:** I've reported only the observed trajectory, not any prediction. The Week 27 figure remains provisional. Regional spread moved from Kyushu → western Japan/Chugoku → greater Tokyo across Weeks 24–25, with Shimane leading at 18.00 in Week 27.
